descripcion: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: Bluetooth: L2CAP: Reject mode changes on connected channels A peer can send a configuration response with an RFC option for another mode to a connected channel, for example to switch it from Streaming to ERTM mode. l2cap_parse_conf_rsp() then changes chan->mode, but l2cap_ertm_init() is not called again, so the ERTM sequence lists are never allocated. The next out-of-sequence I-frame makes l2cap_seq_list_clear() write through the NULL srej_list.list. Refuse the channel when a response tries to change the mode of a connected channel. 25/11/2026 25/11/2026 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: Bluetooth: L2CAP: Reject invalid TxWindow in configuration requests A peer can send an ERTM RFC option with a TxWindow of zero, which is out of spec. It is stored in remote_tx_win unchanged and later passed to l2cap_seq_list_init(), where roundup_pow_of_two(0) is undefined. On some architectures this results in a ZERO_SIZE_PTR list and a remote kernel oops. A TxWindow above 63 is out of spec as well. With 6-bit sequence numbers we would then send more unacknowledged frames than the sequence space can tell apart. Reply with L2CAP_CONF_UNACCEPT and propose the default TxWindow instead of accepting the value, so remote_tx_win always stays within 1 to 63. Keep the parameters of an earlier request then, and do not treat the request as done because an earlier one was. Also refuse a zero size in l2cap_seq_list_init(), so any other path that reaches it with a zero TxWindow fails the channel instead of the kernel. 25/11/2026 25/11/2026 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: Bluetooth: L2CAP: Use default TxWindow for zero socket option L2CAP_OPTIONS accepts a txwin_size of zero and stores it in tx_win. The zero is then sent to the peer in our configuration request, and if the channel ends up in ERTM mode it is passed to l2cap_seq_list_init(). Use the default TxWindow instead, as the mode can still be changed to ERTM during configuration. 25/11/2026 25/11/2026 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: vfio/platform: prevent read-only region mappings from becoming writable vfio_platform_mmap() rejects writable mappings of regions without the WRITE flag, but leaves VM_MAYWRITE set. Userspace can map such a region read-only and then upgrade the mapping to writable with mprotect(). Clear VM_MAYWRITE for regions without the WRITE flag, as i915 does for its read-only objects and as fixed in drm/vc4 (CVE-2026-68445), drm/panthor (CVE-2024-53071) and commit a5edadbae57e ("ptp: vmclock: prevent read-only mappings from becoming writable"). Note this is defensive hardening: no in-tree platform driver currently publishes a region without the WRITE flag. The guard costs nothing and keeps the mmap() interface honest if a read-only region ever appears. 25/11/2026 25/11/2026 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: vfio/fsl-mc: prevent read-only region mappings from becoming writable vfio_fsl_mc_mmap() rejects writable mappings of regions without the WRITE flag, but leaves VM_MAYWRITE set. Userspace can map such a region read-only and then upgrade the mapping to writable with mprotect(). Clear VM_MAYWRITE for regions without the WRITE flag, as i915 does for its read-only objects and as fixed in drm/vc4 (CVE-2026-68445), drm/panthor (CVE-2024-53071) and commit a5edadbae57e ("ptp: vmclock: prevent read-only mappings from becoming writable"). Note this is defensive hardening: the fsl-mc bus publishes all device regions with the WRITE flag set, so no device can currently reach the read-only path. The guard costs nothing and keeps the mmap() interface honest if a read-only region ever appears. 25/11/2026 25/11/2026 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: vfio/cdx: prevent read-only region mappings from becoming writable vfio_cdx_mmap() rejects writable mappings of regions without the WRITE flag, but leaves VM_MAYWRITE set. Userspace can map such a region read-only and then upgrade the mapping to writable with mprotect(), writing to MMIO regions the device marks read-only. Clear VM_MAYWRITE for regions without the WRITE flag, as i915 does for its read-only objects and as fixed in drm/vc4 (CVE-2026-68445), drm/panthor (CVE-2024-53071) and commit a5edadbae57e ("ptp: vmclock: prevent read-only mappings from becoming writable"). Note this is defensive hardening: no in-tree cdx device currently publishes a region without the WRITE flag. The guard costs nothing and keeps the mmap() interface honest if a read-only region ever appears. 25/11/2026 25/11/2026 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: net: limit priority VLAN untag depth The priority VLAN receive path can repeatedly remove VID 0 tags and retry packet processing. Unlike the read-only VLAN protocol parser, this path has no limit on the number of nested tags it consumes. Each skb_vlan_untag() advances skb->data and resets header offsets. The offsets are stored in 16-bit fields. With enough nested tags, the network or transport offset can wrap. A later protocol handler can then derive a large pull length from the wrapped offsets and access memory outside the skb allocation. Apply the existing VLAN_MAX_DEPTH limit to the exceptional VID 0 retry. Count the tag already stored in skb VLAN metadata as the first level, then stop before untagging a ninth level. Keep the accounting inside this uncommon branch so the regular VLAN receive path is unaffected. A single VID 0 priority tag before a real VLAN tag is valid. No normal deployment was found that intentionally emits multiple consecutive VID 0 tags; permitting eight levels is therefore conservative. The issue was found while researching the Linux network receive path for Google kvmCTF, with OpenAI Codex (gpt-5.6-sol) assisting the analysis. The affected path, reproducer and fix were manually reviewed and tested. 25/11/2026 25/11/2026 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis

Camunda 8.8.0 before 8.8.47, 8.9.0 before 8.9.29, 8.10.0 before 8.10.10, and 8.11.0-alpha1 contain an insecure deserialization vulnerability in the persistent web session feature, which stores session attributes as Java-serialized data in secondary storage and deserializes them via an ObjectInputStream without an ObjectInputFilter. Attackers with write access to the web session index, such as an unauthenticated Elasticsearch cluster deployed via Camunda's docker-compose files, can plant a crafted serialized object and trigger deserialization by presenting a matching session cookie, which combined with a gadget chain like the bundled Commons Collections 3.1-RC1 library can lead to code execution as the Camunda service account. 25/11/2026 25/11/2026 Vector CVSS:4.0 CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:H/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N/E:X/CR:X/IR:X/AR:X/MAV:X/MAC:X/MAT:X/MPR:X/MUI:X/MVC:X/MVI:X/MVA:X/MSC:X/MSI:X/MSA:X/S:X/AU:X/R:X/V:X/RE:X/U:X Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H Gravedad 4.0 9.20 Gravedad 4.0 txt CRITICAL Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 8.10 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) HIGH

A vulnerability was detected in slowlyo owl-admin up to 4.7.7. The impacted element is the function update of the file src/Services/AdminUserService.php of the component Admin User Management. The manipulation results in missing authorization. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. Upgrading to version 4.7.8 is sufficient to resolve this issue. The patch is identified as 70910338c1e136d5bdd6ed795768e7a81445f422. The affected component should be upgraded. 25/11/2026 25/11/2026 Vector CVSS:4.0 CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:L/UI:N/VC:L/VI:L/VA:L/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N/E:P/CR:X/IR:X/AR:X/MAV:X/MAC:X/MAT:X/MPR:X/MUI:X/MVC:X/MVI:X/MVA:X/MSC:X/MSI:X/MSA:X/S:X/AU:X/R:X/V:X/RE:X/U:X Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L Vector CVSS:2.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:S/C:P/I:P/A:P Gravedad 4.0 2.10 Gravedad 4.0 txt LOW Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 6.30 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

A vulnerability was identified in slowlyo owl-admin up to 4.7.7. Affected by this issue is the function fillModelFromData of the file src/Services/AdminService.php. The manipulation of the argument id/remember_token/enabled leads to dynamically-determined object attributes. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. Upgrading to version 4.7.8 can resolve this issue. The identifier of the patch is 9b0c98dc3e2710b2ba8d7579da89ec6a4042fcc8.
